summary: Phase 3 (Product Variants) — backend 16/16 pytest PASS (extra + absolute price modes, base-price recompute, variant-only stock recompute, dedupe/blank/negative-clamp, public detail w/ variant_guide, list w/o variants[], variant_required 400, sold-out 400, two-variants-two-rows, adjust beyond stock 400, variant-aware remove, checkout decrement, and oversell prevention). Frontend product page variant UI verified: 'from ₹499' headline, all 4 size chips (S/M/L/XL) with testIDs, L sold-out struck-through + non-tappable, 'Pick a size' guard on Add-to-Cart, size-guide sheet with Chest/Length/Shoulder table. XL price update to ₹549 and cart-with-variant flow could not be verified through automation because the login form submission did not advance from /login in the headless preview (2 <input>s filled + submit button clicked, but URL stayed /login and downstream requests 401'd). Cart pill test and vendor variant-editor flows were NOT run — recommend E1 self-test or headed browser retest.

integration_issues.flow: buyer login via /login in headless preview
integration_issues.issue: Playwright filled 2 inputs and clicked the login button but the app did not navigate away from /login (URL unchanged, subsequent /api requests returned 401). This blocked the cart-variant-pill and post-add flows. Suspect the submit button needs a specific testID or the form uses a two-step (OTP) path in this build. Not a variants bug — carryover from earlier iterations.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props deprecated warning on many screens — migrate to boxShadow. Reference: multiple RN-Web components.

action_items: E1 self-test in a real browser (or headed Playwright): (d) tap XL and confirm headline & Quantity subtotal both switch to ₹549 and 'only 4 left' shows; (e) qty stepper cap = variant stock (4), not product total (12); (g) Add-to-Cart succeeds after picking XL; cart line shows green XL pill + each = ₹549; removing one size leaves other rows intact.

E1 self-test vendor editor at /vendor/dashboard → header + button: verify (a) 9 variant-chart-<key> chips, (b) footwear_uk shows 5..12 with variant-opt-8 + hint 'Shoes, sandals, slippers (adult)', (c) extra/absolute mode toggle switches column header, (d) selecting options creates variant-stock-<label>/variant-price-<label> rows with computed sell price (base 999 + 100 = ₹1099), (e) product Stock field becomes read-only with computed sum, (f) custom label add, (g) row delete, (h) chart-change clears rows, (i) no horizontal overflow at 390x844, (j) re-open of existing variant product rehydrates chart/mode/rows.

E1 self-test SELECT/pick-size behavior on shop cards: testIDs pick-size-<id>, grid-select-<id>, hslide-select-<id> should open PDP (not blind-add) for variant products; non-variant '+' button still works.
Consider adding data-testid='login-submit-button' (or aria-label) to the login CTA so future automation can drive login end-to-end.
RN-Web deprecation warnings ('shadow*', 'props.pointerEvents') — schedule a migration pass.
critical_code_review_comments: core/variants.py is clean, well-documented, and correctly handles both price modes, cheapest-buyable price selection, sold-out fallback, negative clamp, blank-label drop, and duplicate-label dedup — all verified by pytest.
cart.py _resolve_variant returns friendly 400 with detail.code='variant_required' + options list — matches spec exactly.
products_public.get_product enriches variants with in_stock flag AND keeps sold-out rows visible — matches spec.

server.py checkout uses variants.$.stock atomic decrement with matched-stock predicate ({$gte: qty}) and rollback loop — verified oversell impossible in sequential run; a true concurrent race (threads) would need a stress test but the atomic pattern is correct.

success_rate.frontend: 5/7 checked variant UI checks pass; cart+vendor-editor unverified due to login blocker
